title: Pegboard screwdriver holder: concept
subtitle: 6 Ryobi drivers, each held at two heights so it can't tip · your Menards 3/16" board · X out from the board, Z up · mm

meshes.label: Holder (2 hooks + 2 pins, cups on top, guide holes below)
Your 6 drivers (rough shapes, handle sizes estimated)

scale_note: Real size. Shafts 5.03 / 6.43 mm and the big slotted blade 9.58 mm are your caliper readings; handle and bolster widths are estimates from the photos, to be measured.
notes: Why yours tip: each driver sits in one loose wire ring, so it pivots on it. Here each driver is held at two heights 50 mm apart: the yellow bolster drops into a close cup (45° cone floor, so it self-centres) and the shaft passes through a guide hole in the bottom shelf. Worst-case lean is about 2° (3.5° for the big slotted, whose hole has to pass its 9.6 mm blade). Drop drivers in tip first from above. Hangs on 2 hooks + 2 pins (8 holes apart, 2 rows apart), prints standing as it hangs, supports only under the hooks. To finish it I need handle measurements (see chat).
